title: Why Warner Owns Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium: A Data Deep-Dive
summary: DA Warner averages 64.9 at Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium (SR 160.5) across 32 innings — earning an A+ venue fit grade.
body:
## The Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium Connection

Some players just have a ground that feels like home. For DA Warner, that ground is **Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium** in Hyderabad.

| Metric | At Rajiv | Career |
|--------|------------|--------|
| Average | **64.9** | 37.3 |
| Strike Rate | **160.5** | 139.9 |
| Innings | 32 | 371 |
| Runs | 1623 | 12097 |
| Sixes | 72 | 421 |

## Why This Venue Works

- High altitude (542m) means the ball travels further here


---
*Based on 32 innings at Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium. Analysis by MatchPrism.*
